INSERT INTO ${totalTableName} ( SCHEDULE_DATE, ${codeColumn}, ${codeColumn1}, FINISH_QTY, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME ) SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, ${codeColumn}, ${codeColumn1}, SUM(${class1FinishQtyColumn} + ${class2FinishQtyColumn}) AS FINISH_QTY, MIN(REMARK), MIN(DEL_FLAG), MIN(CREATE_BY), MIN(CREATE_TIME) FROM ${tableName} WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY SCHEDULE_DATE ,${codeColumn} ,${codeColumn1}
